newsitem.title: USA: NEW YORK, March 31 (Reuter) - Wang Laboratorie.
newsitem.headline: NEW YORK, March 31 (Reuter) - Wang Laboratorie.

text.p: Wang Laboratories gave its chairman and chief executive officer,Joseph Tucci, an $8 million cash and stock bonus after he turned down an offer to join Novell Inc, the Wall Street Journal reported Monday.
Tucci encouraged the company to rewrite his contract and give him a $4 million retention bonus, the paper said, citing Wang officials.
The company also promised to give him 230,000 shares of restricted stock, the Journal reported.
